title: DSReg: Provably Recovering Individual World Latents without Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.09457v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Methods that recover individual latent variables of the world, from nonlinear ICA to dictionary learning and causal representation learning, anchor the latents to observations through reconstruction, auxiliary supervision, or distributional asymmetries such as non-Gaussianity. Methods without these anchors, including joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs), identify the latent state only up to a linear transformation, so individual latents remain mixed. We close this gap: individual world latents can be provably recovered with no reconstruction, no decoder, and no labels. The key condition is Structural Diversity: different latents leave distinct dependency footprints on observations, just as no two snowflakes are alike. translated_title: DSReg：无需重建即可可证明地恢复个体世界潜在变量
translated_abstract: 从非线性ICA到字典学习和因果表征学习，恢复世界个体潜在变量的方法通常通过重建、辅助监督或分布不对称性（如非高斯性）将潜在变量锚定到观测上。而缺乏这些锚定机制的方法，包括联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs），只能在线性变换的意义上识别潜在状态，因此个体潜在变量仍然是混合不可分的。我们弥合了这一差距：个体世界潜在变量可以在没有重建、没有解码器、没有标签的情况下被可证明地恢复。关键条件是结构多样性：不同的潜在变量会在观测上留下不同的依赖足迹，就像没有两片雪花是相同的一样。基于LeJEPA所提供的线性可辨识性，我们证明在结构多样性条件下，DSReg（依赖稀疏正则化）可以恢复个体世界潜在变量（精确到符号置换），而无需……
tldr: 该论文提出“结构多样性”条件与依赖稀疏正则化方法DSReg，在无需重建、解码器或标签的情况下，可证明地恢复个体的世界潜在变量。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Structural Diversity condition and Dependency-Sparsity Regularization (DSReg), which provably recovers individual world latents without any reconstruction, decoder, or labels.
